text: The specialty can be conducted in English with a prerequisite of a minimum number of 6 students for Master's degree.Training ObjectivesThe course is designed to train nursing professionals with basic knowledge in humanity and social science, medicine and preventative care as well as the basic theories and skills of nursing, who can be engaged in clinical nursing, preventative care and nursing supervision in the nursing field.Training RequirementsStudengts are required to study and grasp the basic theories and laws and regulations relevant to humanity and social science, preclinical medicine, and preventative health; to understand the basic theory, knowledge and skill of nursing, nursing principle and operating technology of acute and chronic patients, and special nursing and care skills; to apply nursing procedures to conduct overall nursing; and to have such basic abilities as in community health services, nursing management and nursing education with some nursing research capacity.Curriculumhuman anatomy, physiology, pathogenic organism, pathophysiology, pathology, pharmacology, nursing ethics, nursing psychology, health assessment, medical nursing, surgical nursing, nursing for gynecology, obstetrics, and pediatrics, psychiatric nursing, nursing for emergency treatment, community nursing, nursing management and so on.Employment orientationIt is suitable for graduates to be engaged in clinicai nursing, nursing management as well as teaching and research work in hospitals at all levels, medical collages and universities as well as medical research institutions.
